kb_proposals: To share proofs between a finite and a locally finite family of spears, state them over the common structure (E0Surgery.LFSpears: ι, D, disjoint, isClosed, locallyFinite) and give each family a toLFSpears; keep each family's own definitions (sigmaStar, logRad) with identical bodies, so `X.toLFSpears.sigmaStar = X.sigmaStar` is rfl and the old lemmas become one-line terms `Dat.toLFSpears.foo ...` that the elaborator accepts by unfolding, with no rewrite and with downstream `rw [SurgeryData.logRad, if_pos h]` unchanged.

Behaviour preservation across a move can be checked mechanically while the old .olean files are still on disk: readModuleData each old olean and compare every constant's type Expr with the new environment's (`c'.type != c.type`); the only expected absences are on-demand eq_n lemmas and proof-internal match_ auxiliaries.

When inserting a block before a docstring anchor, the `omit … in` line above the docstring belongs to the following declaration: insert before the omit, or the next declaration silently gains an instance argument (here caught by linter.unusedSectionVars and a failed instance search downstream).
